records.title: Young Leaders' Program (YLP) - Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship, GRIPS School of Government and School of Local Governance
records.official_source: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan - hosted at the National Graduate Institute for Policy Studies (GRIPS)
records.deadline_display: No central deadline is published. MEXT states that all application procedures for Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarships are conducted through Japanese embassies, consulates in your countries, or institutions of higher education in Japan, and candidates should ask their own embassy/consulate. GRIPS publishes the application window as a historical reference only: application acceptance period (last year's result) July to October, with results announced the following April.
records.application_period: GRIPS publishes that for the cycle it runs, application acceptance runs July to October (last year's result), enrolment is in October and graduation the following September, with results announced the following April. GRIPS has published the YLP Brochure for 2027-2028. The nominating authority in the applicant's own country sets the operative date; no central deadline exists.
